column2: DANGER News Truck Telescoping Mast Sign – Raised Mast Can Contact Power Lines – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:

Why this sign matters

Raising an ENG or satellite truck mast into overhead lines energizes the truck body and can kill anyone touching it.

Where to post it

Mast control panel and truck body.

Who orders it

Broadcast chief engineer / transmitter site manager / news operations manager.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.333(c)(3) (10 ft clearance for lines up to 50 kV). A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
